description: 合并申万+中信行业成员表（当前有效分类）
script: t_sw = select l1_code, l1_name, l2_code, l2_name, l3_code, l3_name, ts_code, in_date, out_date, "sw" as source from loadTable("{db_meta}", "sync_sw_index_member_Y"); t_ci = select l1_code, l1_name, l2_code, l2_name, l3_code, l3_name, ts_code, in_date, out_date, "ci" as source from loadTable("{db_meta}", "sync_ci_index_member_Y"); unionAll([t_sw, t_ci], false)

description: 每只股票每个交易日所属行业（行情左关联行业成员）
script: daily = select trade_date, ts_code from loadTable("{db_ts}", "sync_daily_data"); etl = select ts_code, source, l1_code, l1_name, l2_code, l2_name, l3_code, l3_name, in_date, out_date from loadTable("{db_meta}", "etl_index_member"); joined = lj(daily, etl, `ts_code); select trade_date, ts_code, source, l1_code, l1_name, l2_code, l2_name, l3_code, l3_name from joined where isNull(in_date) or (trade_date >= temporalParse(in_date, "yyyyMMdd") and (isNull(out_date) or out_date = "" or trade_date < temporalParse(out_date, "yyyyMMdd")))

description: 行情+基本面+行业宽表（每日全量刷新）
script: daily = select trade_date, ts_code, open, high, low, close, pre_close, pct_chg, vol, amount from loadTable("{db_ts}", "sync_daily_data"); basic = select trade_date, ts_code, pe_ttm, pb, total_mv, circ_mv, turnover_rate from loadTable("{db_ts}", "sync_daily_basic"); ind = select trade_date, ts_code, source, l1_code, l1_name, l2_code, l2_name, l3_code, l3_name from loadTable("{db_meta}", "etl_index_member_daily"); t1 = lj(daily, basic, `trade_date`ts_code); lj(t1, ind, `trade_date`ts_code)
